data.body: FIXED and MERGED (Gerrit change 972, commit 56a3ac163). Root cause: ensure_store_mounted_best_effort (bug ad9f's central mount) ran for EVERY dispatched CLI invocation, including --help/-h/help renders, the empty invocation, and unknown subcommands — in any auto-attachable checkout (linked worktree, or clone with a local/origin tickets branch) merely rendering help created .tickets-tracker in the repo root. Fix: _store_mount_eligible gates the central mount on a known subcommand or pure intercept with no help token in argv; per-arm ensure_initialized still owns mounting for store-REQUIRING arms, so nothing loses ad9f's contract (re-pinned by a positive-control test). Regression tests added in tests/interfaces/facades/test_central_mount_gate_ad9f.py: help/usage/unknown never mount; a real known invocation still auto-mounts. AC1 verified directly: the review-plan --help test in a fresh tracker-less worktree passes with no leak and no symlink. LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (CI green on the change tree).
